title: Membership and Belonging
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Membership and belonging means that believers are called to committed, accountable life with the people of God. Christians are not meant to remain isolated from the worship, care, discipline, service, and mission of the church.
summary: Membership and belonging means that believers are called to committed, accountable life with the people of God. Christians are not meant to remain isolated from the worship, care, discipline, service, and mission of the church.
christFocus: Jesus Christ saves people into His body and gives them belonging among His people. In Him, believers are no longer strangers, but members of God’s household.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture does not present the Christian life as isolated spirituality. Believers are added to the gathered people, devoted to teaching, fellowship, breaking of bread, prayer, generosity, and shared worship.

Membership expresses visible belonging and responsibility. It is a way of saying, “These are my people, and I am committed to walking with them under Christ.”

Belonging also means accountability. The church cannot meaningfully care, shepherd, correct, or restore those who refuse any committed relationship to the body.

This doctrine should not be used to pressure people into unsafe control. True belonging is under Christ and His Word, marked by love, truth, humility, and care.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many believers have been shaped by church hurt, consumer culture, or fear of commitment. Others drift from church while still claiming private faith. This doctrine calls believers back to embodied life with Christ’s people.

It also comforts the lonely and rejected. In Christ, belonging is not based on popularity, usefulness, strength, health, or status. God places His people in a body.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Seek faithful belonging in a local church where Christ is honored and Scripture is taught. Do not isolate yourself unnecessarily, and do not treat church as a product to consume. Commit to worship, care, service, accountability, and mission with God’s people.
